pr_title: Extract creation and updated dates from v2 dump
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #2989

## What does this PR do?
This PR extracts the creation and updated dates from v2 dumps. The changes made in this PR are largely referenced from https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/798aa4ee9204ce20ab90054cad3e7a2243544aa3/dump/src/reader/v3/mod.rs#L165-L188

issue_context.title: Extract the dates ouf of the dumpv2
issue_context.body:
When importing a dump v2, we should extract the creation and last updated timestamp.
https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/blob/main/dump/src/reader/v2/mod.rs#L145-L164

The idea is to look at the whole task queue until you find the first task concerning your index (=last_updated_at), and you already have the task_uid of the task_creating it. Thus you then need to continue until you reach this task and extract its date as the creation_date.
